hook: NASA's Voyager 1 went silent for two days in deep space.

sections.voiceover: NASA's Voyager 1 went silent for two days in deep space.
sections.visual_cue: Graphic showing Voyager 1 in the dark void of interstellar space.
sections.sfx_cue: Deep, resonant space drone that cuts to silence.
b_roll: NASA artist rendition of Voyager 1 in interstellar space

sections.voiceover: Engineers at NASA turned off three power-hungry devices on the probe in early September. These systems were replaced with three lower-power alternatives to save energy.
sections.visual_cue: Animated diagram showing three power modules being toggled off.
b_roll: Technical schematic of Voyager 1 power systems

sections.voiceover: On October 20, Voyager 1 experienced an unexpected 48-hour pause in data transmission to NASA.
sections.visual_cue: Visual of a signal wave flatlining on a monitor.
sections.sfx_cue: Static noise that fades into a high-pitched alert tone.
b_roll: Deep Space Network signal monitor graphic

sections.voiceover: Voyager 1 autonomously resolved this 48-hour pause without any commands from NASA engineers. NASA confirms Voyager 1 remains active after successfully substituting those 3 power-hungry devices.
sections.visual_cue: Voyager 1 signal wave returning to a steady pulse.
b_roll: NASA animation of Voyager 1 signal transmission

sections.voiceover: Voyager 1 continues its mission after completing the power-saving strategy in early September.
sections.visual_cue: Slow zoom out from Voyager 1 into the starry expanse.
sections.sfx_cue: Fading echo of a cosmic pulse.
